note: Ken, 1 Nov: every fish in the English daily inbox. Sunday is one of the 24; Monday to Saturday the rest. Made by tools/fish/catch.py

W01a.title: Provide
W01a.bottom: himself a lamb for a burnt offering...
W01a.verse: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.

W01b.title: Create
W01b.verse: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

W01c.title: Walk
W01c.bottom: and he was not; for God took him.
W01c.verse: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.

W02a.title: Bless
W02a.top: I will not let thee go,
W02a.verse: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.
W02a.snip: I will not let thee go

W02b.title: With
W02b.top: And, behold, I am with thee,
W02b.bottom: and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest...
W02b.verse: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.
W02b.snip: And, behold, I am with thee

W03a.title: Deliver
W03a.top: And I am come down to deliver them
W03a.bottom: out of the hand of the Egyptians...
W03a.verse: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
W03a.snip: And I am come down to deliver them

W03b.title: Good
W03b.bottom: but God meant it unto good...
W03b.verse: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

W03c.title: Song
W03c.top: The LORD is my strength and song,
W03c.bottom: and he is become my salvation...
W03c.verse: The LORD is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.
W03c.snip: The LORD is my strength and song

W04a.title: Go
W04a.top: My presence shall go with thee,
W04a.bottom: and I will give thee rest.
W04a.verse: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.
W04a.snip: My presence shall go with thee

W04b.title: Glory
W04b.bottom: I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.
W04b.verse: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.

W05a.title: Holy
W05a.top: For I am the LORD your God...
W05a.bottom: ye shall be holy; for I am holy...
W05a.verse: For I am the LORD your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
W05a.snip: For I am the LORD your God

W05b.title: Atone
W05b.top: For the life of the flesh is in the blood:
W05b.bottom: ...it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.
W05b.verse: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.
W05b.snip: For the life of the flesh is in the blood

W06a.title: Keep
W06a.verse: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:

W06b.title: Proclaim
W06b.top: ...and proclaim liberty throughout all the land
W06b.verse: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.
W06b.snip: ...and proclaim liberty throughout all the land

W07a.title: Look
W07a.bottom: when he looketh upon it, shall live.
W07a.verse: And the LORD said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.

W08a.title: Bread
W08a.top: ...man doth not live by bread only,
W08a.bottom: but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD...
W08a.verse: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.
W08a.snip: ...man doth not live by bread only

W09a.title: Courage
W09a.top: Be strong and of a good courage;
W09a.bottom: ...the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
W09a.verse: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
W09a.snip: Be strong and of a good courage

W10a.title: Serve
W10a.top: ...choose you this day whom ye will serve;
W10a.bottom: ...as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.
W10a.verse: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.
W10a.snip: ...choose you this day whom ye will serve

W10b.title: Refuge
W10b.verse: That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.

W11a.title: Heart
W11a.top: ...for man looketh on the outward appearance,
W11a.bottom: but the LORD looketh on the heart.
W11a.verse: But the LORD said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the Lord seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.
W11a.snip: ...for man looketh on the outward appearance

W11b.title: Redeem
W11b.top: If thou wilt redeem it, redeem it:
W11b.bottom: ...And he said, I will redeem it.
W11b.verse: And I thought to advertise thee, saying, Buy it before the inhabitants, and before the elders of my people. If thou wilt redeem it, redeem it: but if thou wilt not redeem it, then tell me, that I may know: for there is none to redeem it beside thee; and I am after thee. And he said, I will redeem it.
W11b.snip: If thou wilt redeem it, redeem it

W11c.title: Speak
W11c.verse: And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.

W12a.title: Establish
W12a.top: And thine house and thy kingdom
W12a.bottom: shall be established for ever before thee...
W12a.verse: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.
W12a.snip: And thine house and thy kingdom

W12b.title: Battle
W12b.bottom: and he will give you into our hands.
W12b.verse: And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the LORD’s, and he will give you into our hands.

W13a.title: Kindness
W13a.top: Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness
W13a.bottom: ...and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.
W13a.verse: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father’s sake, and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.
W13a.snip: Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness

W13b.title: Understand
W13b.verse: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?

W14a.title: Oil
W14a.verse: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said unto her, There is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.

W14b.title: Double
W14b.top: ...I pray thee, let a double portion
W14b.bottom: of thy spirit be upon me.
W14b.verse: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.
W14b.snip: ...I pray thee, let a double portion

W14c.title: Consume
W14c.top: Then the fire of the LORD fell,
W14c.verse: Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.
W14c.snip: Then the fire of the LORD fell

W14d.title: Voice
W14d.verse: And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.

W15a.title: Heal
W15a.top: I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears:
W15a.verse: Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the LORD.
W15a.snip: I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears

W15b.title: Found
W15b.top: I have found the book of the law
W15b.bottom: in the house of the LORD.
W15b.verse: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.
W15b.snip: I have found the book of the law

W16a.title: Thank
W16a.top: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good;
W16a.bottom: for his mercy endureth for ever.
W16a.verse: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
W16a.snip: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good

W17a.title: Humble
W17a.top: If my people... shall humble themselves, and pray,
W17a.bottom: ...then will I hear from heaven... and will heal their land.
W17a.verse: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
W17a.snip: If my people... shall humble themselves, and pray

W18a.title: Return
W18a.top: ...the LORD your God is gracious and merciful,
W18a.bottom: and will not turn away his face from you, if ye return unto him.
W18a.verse: For if ye turn again unto the LORD, your brethren and your children shall find compassion before them that lead them captive, so that they shall come again into this land: for the LORD your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you, if ye return unto him.
W18a.snip: ...the LORD your God is gracious and merciful

W19a.title: Strength
W19a.bottom: for the joy of the LORD is your strength.
W19a.verse: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.

W19b.title: Build
W19b.top: The God of heaven, he will prosper us;
W19b.bottom: therefore we his servants will arise and build...
W19b.verse: Then answered I them, and said unto them, The God of heaven, he will prosper us; therefore we his servants will arise and build: but ye have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.
W19b.snip: The God of heaven, he will prosper us

W19c.title: Time
W19c.top: ...who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom
W19c.bottom: for such a time as this?
W19c.verse: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father’s house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?
W19c.snip: ...who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom

W20a.title: Redeemer
W20a.top: For I know that my redeemer liveth,
W20a.bottom: and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth.
W20a.verse: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:
W20a.snip: For I know that my redeemer liveth

W21a.title: Gold
W21a.top: But he knoweth the way that I take:
W21a.bottom: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
W21a.verse: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
W21a.snip: But he knoweth the way that I take

W21b.title: Meditate
W21b.top: But his delight is in the law of the LORD;
W21b.bottom: and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
W21b.verse: But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
W21b.snip: But his delight is in the law of the LORD

W22a.title: Shepherd
W22a.verse: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

W23a.title: Still
W23a.top: Be still, and know that I am God:
W23a.bottom: I will be exalted among the heathen...
W23a.verse: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
W23a.snip: Be still, and know that I am God

W23b.title: Light
W23b.top: The LORD is my light and my salvation;
W23b.verse: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
W23b.snip: The LORD is my light and my salvation

W23c.title: Taste
W23c.top: O taste and see that the LORD is good:
W23c.bottom: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
W23c.verse: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
W23c.snip: O taste and see that the LORD is good

W24a.title: Wash
W24a.top: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean:
W24a.bottom: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
W24a.verse: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
W24a.snip: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean

W24b.title: Thirst
W24b.top: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee:
W24b.verse: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
W24b.snip: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee

W25a.title: Fortress
W25a.top: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress:
W25a.bottom: my God; in him will I trust.
W25a.verse: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
W25a.snip: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress

W25b.title: Dwell
W25b.top: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High
W25b.bottom: shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
W25b.verse: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
W25b.snip: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High

W26a.title: Worship
W26a.top: O come, let us worship and bow down:
W26a.bottom: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.
W26a.verse: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.
W26a.snip: O come, let us worship and bow down

W26b.title: Enter
W26b.top: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving,
W26b.bottom: and into his courts with praise...
W26b.verse: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
W26b.snip: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving

W27a.title: Lamp
W27a.top: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet,
W27a.bottom: and a light unto my path.
W27a.verse: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
W27a.snip: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet

W27b.title: Made
W27b.bottom: for I am fearfully and wonderfully made...
W27b.verse: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.

W28a.title: Praise
W28a.top: Let every thing that hath breath
W28a.bottom: praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
W28a.verse: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
W28a.snip: Let every thing that hath breath

W28b.title: Direct
W28b.top: In all thy ways acknowledge him,
W28b.bottom: and he shall direct thy paths.
W28b.verse: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
W28b.snip: In all thy ways acknowledge him

W29a.title: Wisdom
W29a.top: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold!
W29a.bottom: and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
W29a.verse: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
W29a.snip: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold!

W29b.title: Run
W29b.top: The name of the LORD is a strong tower:
W29b.bottom: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
W29b.verse: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
W29b.snip: The name of the LORD is a strong tower

W29c.title: Season
W29c.top: To every thing there is a season,
W29c.bottom: and a time to every purpose under the heaven.
W29c.verse: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:
W29c.snip: To every thing there is a season

W30a.title: Send
W30a.top: Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?
W30a.bottom: Then said I, Here am I; send me.
W30a.verse: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.
W30a.snip: Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?

W30b.title: Behold
W30b.top: Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son,
W30b.bottom: and shall call his name Immanuel.
W30b.verse: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
W30b.snip: Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son

W30c.title: Reason
W30c.top: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD:
W30c.bottom: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow...
W30c.verse: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
W30c.snip: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD

W31a.title: Peace
W31a.top: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace,
W31a.bottom: whose mind is stayed on thee...
W31a.verse: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
W31a.snip: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace

W31b.title: Wonder
W31b.top: ...and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor,
W31b.bottom: The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
W31b.verse: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
W31b.snip: ...and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor

W32a.title: Wait
W32a.top: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength;
W32a.bottom: they shall mount up with wings as eagles...
W32a.verse: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
W32a.snip: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength

W32b.title: Comfort
W32b.top: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people,
W32b.verse: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.
W32b.snip: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people

W32c.title: Name
W32c.top: Fear not: for I have redeemed thee,
W32c.bottom: I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.
W32c.verse: But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.
W32c.snip: Fear not: for I have redeemed thee

W32d.title: Wound
W32d.top: But he was wounded for our transgressions,
W32d.bottom: ...and with his stripes we are healed.
W32d.verse: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
W32d.snip: But he was wounded for our transgressions

W33a.title: Come
W33a.top: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters...
W33a.bottom: ...come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
W33a.verse: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
W33a.snip: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters

W33b.title: Arise
W33b.top: Arise, shine; for thy light is come,
W33b.bottom: and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
W33b.verse: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
W33b.snip: Arise, shine; for thy light is come

W34a.title: Find
W34a.top: And ye shall seek me, and find me,
W34a.bottom: when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
W34a.verse: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
W34a.snip: And ye shall seek me, and find me

W34b.title: Clay
W34b.top: Behold, as the clay is in the potter’s hand,
W34b.bottom: so are ye in mine hand...
W34b.verse: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the LORD. Behold, as the clay is in the potter’s hand, so are ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.
W34b.snip: Behold, as the clay is in the potter’s hand

W34c.title: Hard
W34c.top: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth...
W34c.bottom: ...there is nothing too hard for thee.
W34c.verse: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for thee:
W34c.snip: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth

W35a.title: New
W35a.bottom: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
W35a.verse: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

W35b.title: Call
W35b.top: Call unto me, and I will answer thee,
W35b.bottom: and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
W35b.verse: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
W35b.snip: Call unto me, and I will answer thee

W36a.title: Turn
W36a.top: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth...
W36a.verse: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord GOD: wherefore turn yourselves, and live ye.
W36a.snip: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth

W36b.title: Spirit
W36b.top: ...and I will put a new spirit within you;
W36b.bottom: and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh...
W36b.verse: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:
W36b.snip: ...and I will put a new spirit within you

W37a.title: Stand
W37a.top: And I sought for a man among them,
W37a.bottom: that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap...
W37a.verse: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.
W37a.snip: And I sought for a man among them

W37b.title: Search
W37b.top: Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep,
W37b.verse: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.
W37b.snip: Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep

W38a.title: River
W38a.top: ...whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live:
W38a.bottom: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish...
W38a.verse: And it shall come to pass, that every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river cometh.
W38a.snip: ...whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live

W38b.title: Faithful
W38b.top: ...but they could find none occasion nor fault;
W38b.verse: Then the presidents and princes sought to find occasion against Daniel concerning the kingdom; but they could find none occasion nor fault; forasmuch as he was faithful, neither was there any error or fault found in him.
W38b.snip: ...but they could find none occasion nor fault

W39a.title: Restore
W39a.top: And I will restore to you
W39a.bottom: the years that the locust hath eaten...
W39a.verse: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.
W39a.snip: And I will restore to you

W39b.title: Prepare
W39b.top: Now the LORD had prepared a great fish
W39b.verse: Now the LORD had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
W39b.snip: Now the LORD had prepared a great fish

W39c.title: Pour
W39c.top: ...I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh;
W39c.bottom: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy...
W39c.verse: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:
W39c.snip: ...I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh

W40a.title: Pardon
W40a.top: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity...
W40a.bottom: ...he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.
W40a.verse: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.
W40a.snip: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity

W40b.title: Write
W40b.top: Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables,
W40b.bottom: that he may run that readeth it.
W40b.verse: And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.
W40b.snip: Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables

W40c.title: Joy
W40c.top: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save,
W40c.bottom: he will rejoice over thee with joy...
W40c.verse: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.
W40c.snip: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save

W41a.title: Fish
W41a.top: And he saith unto them, Follow me,
W41a.bottom: and I will make you fishers of men.
W41a.verse: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.
W41a.snip: And he saith unto them, Follow me

W41b.title: King
W41b.bottom: he is just, and having salvation; lowly...
W41b.verse: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.

W41c.title: Daily
W41c.verse: Give us this day our daily bread.

W41d.title: Shine
W41d.top: Let your light so shine before men,
W41d.bottom: that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father...
W41d.verse: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
W41d.snip: Let your light so shine before men

W42a.title: Teach
W42a.top: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations,
W42a.bottom: baptizing them in the name of the Father...
W42a.verse: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
W42a.snip: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations

W42b.title: Faith
W42b.top: ...If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed...
W42b.verse: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
W42b.snip: ...If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed

W42c.title: Prevail
W42c.top: ...and upon this rock I will build my church;
W42c.bottom: and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
W42c.verse: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
W42c.snip: ...and upon this rock I will build my church

W43a.title: Launch
W43a.bottom: and let down your nets for a draught.
W43a.verse: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.

W43b.title: Saviour
W43b.top: For unto you is born this day in the city of David
W43b.bottom: a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
W43b.verse: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
W43b.snip: For unto you is born this day in the city of David

W43c.title: Possible
W43c.bottom: all things are possible to him that believeth.
W43c.verse: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.

W44a.title: Free
W44a.top: If the Son therefore shall make you free,
W44a.verse: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
W44a.snip: If the Son therefore shall make you free

W44b.title: Alive
W44b.top: For this my son was dead, and is alive again;
W44b.bottom: he was lost, and is found.
W44b.verse: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.
W44b.snip: For this my son was dead, and is alive again

W44c.title: Born
W44c.top: Verily, verily, I say unto thee,
W44c.bottom: Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
W44c.verse: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
W44c.snip: Verily, verily, I say unto thee

W44d.title: Drink
W44d.top: ...whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him
W44d.verse: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
W44d.snip: ...whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him

W45a.title: Abide
W45a.top: Abide in me, and I in you.
W45a.bottom: As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine...
W45a.verse: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
W45a.snip: Abide in me, and I in you

W45b.title: Finish
W45b.bottom: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
W45b.verse: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.

W45c.title: Cast
W45c.top: Cast the net on the right side of the ship,
W45c.verse: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.
W45c.snip: Cast the net on the right side of the ship

W45d.title: Way
W45d.top: I am the way, the truth, and the life:
W45d.bottom: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
W45d.verse: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
W45d.snip: I am the way, the truth, and the life

W45e.title: Power
W45e.bottom: after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you...
W45e.verse: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

W46a.title: Life
W46a.top: For the wages of sin is death;
W46a.bottom: but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
W46a.verse: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
W46a.snip: For the wages of sin is death

W46b.title: Save
W46b.top: Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ,
W46b.bottom: and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.
W46b.verse: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.
W46b.snip: Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ

W46c.title: Abound
W46c.verse: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:

W47a.title: Transform
W47a.top: And be not conformed to this world:
W47a.bottom: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind...
W47a.verse: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
W47a.snip: And be not conformed to this world

W47b.title: Confess
W47b.top: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus,
W47b.verse: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
W47b.snip: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus

W47c.title: Work
W47c.top: And we know that all things work together for good
W47c.verse: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
W47c.snip: And we know that all things work together for good

W48a.title: Grace
W48a.top: My grace is sufficient for thee:
W48a.bottom: for my strength is made perfect in weakness.
W48a.verse: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
W48a.snip: My grace is sufficient for thee

W48b.title: Victory
W48b.top: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory
W48b.verse: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
W48b.snip: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory

W48c.title: Fruit
W48c.top: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace,
W48c.verse: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
W48c.snip: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace

W49a.title: Gift
W49a.top: For by grace are ye saved through faith;
W49a.bottom: and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God.
W49a.verse: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:
W49a.snip: For by grace are ye saved through faith

W49b.title: Rejoice
W49b.verse: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

W49c.title: Press
W49c.top: I press toward the mark for the prize
W49c.bottom: of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
W49c.verse: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
W49c.snip: I press toward the mark for the prize

W49d.title: Armour
W49d.top: Put on the whole armour of God,
W49d.bottom: that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
W49d.verse: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
W49d.snip: Put on the whole armour of God

W50a.title: Word
W50a.top: For the word of God is quick, and powerful,
W50a.bottom: and sharper than any twoedged sword...
W50a.verse: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
W50a.snip: For the word of God is quick, and powerful

W50b.title: Bold
W50b.top: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace,
W50b.bottom: that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
W50b.verse: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
W50b.snip: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace

W50c.title: Fight
W50c.top: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course,
W50c.verse: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
W50c.snip: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course

W51a.title: Patience
W51a.bottom: the race that is set before us.
W51a.verse: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

W51b.title: Evidence
W51b.top: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for,
W51b.bottom: the evidence of things not seen.
W51b.verse: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
W51b.snip: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for

W51c.title: Care
W51c.top: Casting all your care upon him;
W51c.verse: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
W51c.snip: Casting all your care upon him

W52a.title: Amen
W52a.verse: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.

W52b.title: Open
W52b.top: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock:
W52b.bottom: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in...
W52b.verse: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
W52b.snip: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock

W52c.title: Take
W52c.bottom: let him take the water of life freely.
W52c.verse: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.

W52d.title: Worthy
W52d.top: Worthy is the Lamb that was slain
W52d.bottom: to receive power, and riches, and wisdom...
W52d.verse: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.
W52d.snip: Worthy is the Lamb that was slain

D648.title: Feed
D648.bottom: thou knowest that I love thee... Feed my sheep.
D648.verse: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

X001.title: Stop
X001.top: Sober up as you ought, and stop sinning;
X001.bottom: for some of you are ignorant of God...
X001.verse: Sober up as you ought, and stop sinning; for some of you are ignorant of God. I say this to your shame.
X001.snip: Sober up as you ought, and stop sinning

X002.title: Go
X002.top: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way;
X002.bottom: and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee.

X002.snip: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way

X003.title: Repent
X003.top: Repent ye therefore, and be converted,
X003.bottom: that your sins may be blotted out...
X003.verse: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
X003.snip: Repent ye therefore, and be converted

X004.title: Build
X004.top: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves
X004.bottom: on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost...
X004.verse: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,
X004.snip: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves

X005.title: Deliver
X005.top: Who delivered us from so great a death,
X005.bottom: and doth deliver: … he will yet deliver us
X005.verse: Who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;
X005.snip: Who delivered us from so great a death

X006.title: Remember
X006.top: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen,
X006.bottom: and repent, and do the first works; …
X006.verse: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.
X006.snip: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen

D271.title: Raise
D271.top: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David
D271.bottom: that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof...
D271.verse: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up his ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old:
D271.snip: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David

D365.title: Seed
D365.top: between thy seed and her seed;
D365.bottom: it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.

D365.snip: between thy seed and her seed

D366.top: And the LORD said unto Noah,
D366.bottom: Come thou and all thy house into the ark...

D366.snip: And the LORD said unto Noah

D003.title: Covenant
D003.top: I do set my bow in the cloud,
D003.bottom: and it shall be for a token of a covenant...
D003.verse: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.
D003.snip: I do set my bow in the cloud

D367.title: Land
D367.top: Get thee out of thy country...
D367.bottom: unto a land that I will shew thee:
D367.verse: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father’s house, unto a land that I will shew thee:
D367.snip: Get thee out of thy country

D004.title: Shield
D004.top: Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield,
D004.verse: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.
D004.snip: Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield

D005.title: Almighty
D005.bottom: walk before me, and be thou perfect.
D005.verse: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the LORD appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.

D368.title: Judge
D368.bottom: of all the earth do right?
D368.verse: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?

D369.title: Hold
D369.top: the men laid hold upon his hand...
D369.bottom: the LORD being merciful unto him...
D369.verse: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the LORD being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.
D369.snip: the men laid hold upon his hand

D007.title: Visit
D007.verse: And the LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did unto Sarah as he had spoken.

D008.title: Way
D008.verse: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, the LORD led me to the house of my master’s brethren.

D370.title: Room
D370.top: For now the LORD hath made room for us,
D370.bottom: and we shall be fruitful in the land.
D370.verse: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now the LORD hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.
D370.snip: For now the LORD hath made room for us

D371.title: Plenty

D371.bottom: and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:
D371.verse: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:
D371.snip: God give thee of the dew of heaven

D372.title: Remember
D372.verse: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.

D373.title: Watch
D373.top: The LORD watch between me and thee,
D373.bottom: when we are absent one from another.
D373.verse: And Mizpah; for he said, The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.
D373.snip: The LORD watch between me and thee

D374.title: Altar
D374.top: I will make there an altar unto God,
D374.bottom: who answered me in the day of my distress...
D374.verse: And let us arise, and go up to Beth-el; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.
D374.snip: I will make there an altar unto God

D375.title: Generation

D011.title: Deliver
D011.top: And Reuben heard it, and he delivered
D011.verse: And Reuben heard it , and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.
D011.snip: And Reuben heard it, and he delivered

D376.title: Acknowledge
D376.top: And Judah acknowledged them, and said,

D376.verse: And Judah acknowledged them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.
D376.snip: And Judah acknowledged them, and said

D012.title: Prosper
D012.top: And the LORD was with Joseph,
D012.bottom: and he was a prosperous man...

D378.bottom: in that we saw the anguish of his soul...

D378.snip: We are verily guilty concerning our brother

D379.top: for his bowels did yearn upon his brother:
D379.bottom: and he sought where to weep...

D379.snip: for his bowels did yearn upon his brother

D013.verse: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.

D381.title: Nourish
D381.bottom: and his brethren, and all his father's household...
D381.verse: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father’s household, with bread, according to their families.

D382.title: Sceptre

D382.bottom: until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering...

D383.title: Teach

D017.title: People

D384.title: Finger

D384.snip: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh

D385.title: Light

D385.snip: but all the children of Israel

D387.snip: And the LORD went before them by day

D388.bottom: which the LORD hath given you to eat.

D020.title: Wings

D022.title: Keep

D022.snip: Behold, I send an Angel before thee

D023.title: Meet

D203.bottom: ...if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow...
D203.verse: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour. For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.

D204.title: Patient
D204.top: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning...
D204.bottom: ...the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
D204.verse: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof: and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
D204.snip: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning

D544.title: Might
D544.top: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do,
D544.verse: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.
D544.snip: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do

D205.title: Creator
D205.bottom: in the days of thy youth...
D205.verse: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;

D207.title: Beloved
D207.top: I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine:
D207.verse: I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine: he feedeth among the lilies.
D207.snip: I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine

D545.title: Beat
D545.top: they shall beat their swords into plowshares,
D545.verse: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
D545.snip: they shall beat their swords into plowshares

D212.title: Draw
D212.top: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water
D212.bottom: out of the wells of salvation.
D212.verse: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.
D212.snip: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water

D546.title: Rest
D546.top: the LORD shall give thee rest from thy sorrow,
D546.verse: And it shall come to pass in the day that the LORD shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve,
D546.snip: the LORD shall give thee rest from thy sorrow

D213.title: Maker
D213.top: At that day shall a man look to his Maker,
D213.bottom: and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.
D213.verse: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.
D213.snip: At that day shall a man look to his Maker

D214.title: Open
D214.top: And the key of the house of David...
D214.bottom: ...so he shall open, and none shall shut...
D214.verse: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.
D214.snip: And the key of the house of David

D547.title: Voice
D547.top: They shall lift up their voice,
D547.bottom: they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD...
D547.verse: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD, they shall cry aloud from the sea.
D547.snip: They shall lift up their voice

D217.title: Stone
D217.top: Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone,
D217.bottom: a tried stone, a precious corner stone...
D217.verse: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD , Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone , a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.
D217.snip: Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone

D216.title: Quiet
D216.top: In returning and rest shall ye be saved;
D216.bottom: in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength...
D216.verse: For thus saith the Lord GOD , the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.
D216.snip: In returning and rest shall ye be saved

D218.title: Shadow
D218.top: ...as rivers of water in a dry place,
D218.bottom: as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
D218.verse: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
D218.snip: ...as rivers of water in a dry place

D219.title: Return
D219.top: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return,
D219.bottom: and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy...
D219.verse: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
D219.snip: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return

D548.title: Spread
D548.top: Hezekiah went up unto the house of the LORD,
D548.bottom: and spread it before the LORD.
D548.verse: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.
D548.snip: Hezekiah went up unto the house of the LORD

D549.title: Hold
D549.top: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand,
D549.bottom: saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
D549.verse: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
D549.snip: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand

D222.title: Carry
D222.top: And even to your old age I am he;
D222.bottom: and even to hoar hairs will I carry you...
D222.verse: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you .
D222.snip: And even to your old age I am he

D550.title: Chosen
D550.top: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver;
D550.bottom: I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.
D550.verse: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.
D550.snip: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver

D551.title: Palms
D551.top: I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands;
D551.bottom: thy walls are continually before me.
D551.verse: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.
D551.snip: I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands

D224.title: Tidings
D224.top: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet
D224.bottom: of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace...
D224.verse: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!
D224.snip: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet

D552.title: Guide
D552.top: And the LORD shall guide thee continually,...
D552.bottom: thou shalt be like a watered garden...
D552.verse: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
D552.snip: And the LORD shall guide thee continually

D227.title: Crown
D227.top: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory
D227.bottom: in the hand of the LORD...
D227.verse: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD , and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.
D227.snip: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory

D553.title: Potter
D553.top: But now, O LORD, thou art our father;
D553.bottom: we are the clay, and thou our potter...
D553.verse: But now, O LORD, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.
D553.snip: But now, O LORD, thou art our father

D554.title: Mother
D554.top: As one whom his mother comforteth,
D554.verse: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
D554.snip: As one whom his mother comforteth

D228.title: Waters
D228.verse: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.

D555.title: Pastor
D555.top: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart,
D555.bottom: which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.
D555.verse: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.
D555.snip: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart

D229.title: Soul
D229.top: ...ask for the old paths, where is the good way,
D229.bottom: and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls.
D229.verse: Thus saith the LORD , Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk therein .
D229.snip: ...ask for the old paths, where is the good way

D231.title: Obey
D231.top: Obey my voice, and I will be your God,
D231.bottom: and ye shall be my people...
D231.verse: But this thing commanded I them, saying, Obey my voice, and I will be your God, and ye shall be my people: and walk ye in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well unto you.
D231.snip: Obey my voice, and I will be your God

D230.title: Glory
D230.top: ...let him that glorieth glory in this,
D230.bottom: that he understandeth and knoweth me...
D230.verse: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I am the LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the LORD .
D230.snip: ...let him that glorieth glory in this

D556.title: Contend
D556.top: If thou hast run with the footmen,
D556.bottom: and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend...
D556.verse: If thou hast run with the footmen, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and if in the land of peace, wherein thou trustedst, they wearied thee, then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan?
D556.snip: If thou hast run with the footmen

D232.title: Name
D232.bottom: art in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name...
D232.verse: Why shouldest thou be as a man astonied, as a mighty man that cannot save? yet thou, O LORD , art in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name; leave us not.

D557.title: Eat
D557.top: Thy words were found, and I did eat them;
D557.bottom: and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing...
D557.verse: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O LORD God of hosts.
D557.snip: Thy words were found, and I did eat them

D558.title: Burn
D558.top: But his word was in mine heart
D558.bottom: as a burning fire shut up in my bones...
D558.verse: Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name. But his word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with forbearing, and I could not stay.
D558.snip: But his word was in mine heart

D559.title: Way
D559.bottom: the way of life, and the way of death.
D559.verse: And unto this people thou shalt say, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I set before you the way of life, and the way of death.

D235.title: Reign
D235.top: ...I will raise unto David a righteous Branch,
D235.bottom: and a King shall reign and prosper...
D235.verse: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD , that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.
D235.snip: ...I will raise unto David a righteous Branch

D560.title: Good
D560.top: For I will set mine eyes upon them for good,
D560.bottom: and I will bring them again to this land...
D560.verse: For I will set mine eyes upon them for good, and I will bring them again to this land: and I will build them, and not pull them down; and I will plant them, and not pluck them up.
D560.snip: For I will set mine eyes upon them for good

D236.title: Amend
D236.top: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings,
D236.bottom: and obey the voice of the LORD your God...
D236.verse: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of the LORD your God; and the LORD will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you.
D236.snip: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings

D561.title: Give
D561.top: I have made the earth... by my outstretched arm,
D561.bottom: and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me.
D561.verse: I have made the earth, the man and the beast that are upon the ground, by my great power and by my outstretched arm, and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me.
D561.snip: I have made the earth... by my outstretched arm

D562.title: Write
D562.top: I will put my law in their inward parts,
D562.bottom: and write it in their hearts...
D562.verse: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the LORD, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.
D562.snip: I will put my law in their inward parts

D563.title: Liberty
D563.top: and had done right in my sight,
D563.bottom: in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour...
D563.verse: And ye were now turned, and had done right in my sight, in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour; and ye had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name:
D563.snip: and had done right in my sight

D564.title: Roll
D564.bottom: and write in it all the former words...
D564.verse: Take thee again another roll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first roll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah hath burned.

D240.title: Trust
D240.top: For I will surely deliver thee...
D240.bottom: ...because thou hast put thy trust in me, saith the LORD.
D240.verse: For I will surely deliver thee, and thou shalt not fall by the sword, but thy life shall be for a prey unto thee: because thou hast put thy trust in me, saith the LORD .
D240.snip: For I will surely deliver thee

D565.title: Loose
D565.top: And now, behold, I loose thee this day
D565.bottom: from the chains which were upon thine hand...
D565.verse: And now, behold, I loose thee this day from the chains which were upon thine hand. If it seem good unto thee to come with me into Babylon, come; and I will look well unto thee: but if it seem ill unto thee to come with me into Babylon, forbear: behold, all the land is before thee: whither it seemeth good and convenient for thee to go, thither go.
D565.snip: And now, behold, I loose thee this day

D241.title: Plant
D241.top: ...then will I build you, and not pull you down,
D241.bottom: and I will plant you, and not pluck you up...
D241.verse: If ye will still abide in this land, then will I build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up: for I repent me of the evil that I have done unto you.
D241.snip: ...then will I build you, and not pull you down

D566.title: Send
D566.top: I sent unto you all my servants the prophets,
D566.verse: Howbeit I sent unto you all my servants the prophets, rising early and sending them, saying, Oh, do not this abominable thing that I hate.
D566.snip: I sent unto you all my servants the prophets

D242.title: With
D242.top: Fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith the LORD:
D242.verse: Fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith the LORD : for I am with thee; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee: but I will not make a full end of thee, but correct thee in measure; yet will I not leave thee wholly unpunished.
D242.snip: Fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith the LORD

D567.title: Bring
D567.top: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab
D567.bottom: in the latter days, saith the LORD...
D567.verse: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith the LORD. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
D567.snip: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab

D568.title: Preserve
D568.bottom: I will preserve them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.
D568.verse: Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.

D243.title: Pardon
D243.top: ...the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for,
D243.bottom: and there shall be none... for I will pardon them...
D243.verse: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD , the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.
D243.snip: ...the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for

D569.title: Declare
D569.top: The LORD hath brought forth our righteousness:
D569.bottom: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God.
D569.verse: The LORD hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God.
D569.snip: The LORD hath brought forth our righteousness

D570.title: Bread
D570.bottom: and he did continually eat bread before him...
D570.verse: And changed his prison garments: and he did continually eat bread before him all the days of his life.

D571.title: Sorrow
D571.top: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by?
D571.bottom: behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow...
D571.verse: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the LORD hath afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.
D571.snip: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by?

D246.title: Throne
D246.top: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever;
D246.bottom: thy throne from generation to generation.
D246.verse: Thou, O LORD , remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.
D246.snip: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever

D247.title: Watchman
D247.top: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman
D247.bottom: ...therefore hear the word at my mouth...
D247.verse: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.
D247.snip: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman

D572.title: Bear
D572.top: according to the number of the days
D572.bottom: that thou shalt lie upon it thou shalt bear their iniquity.
D572.verse: Lie thou also upon thy left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it: according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon it thou shalt bear their iniquity.
D572.snip: according to the number of the days

D573.title: Escape
D573.top: Yet will I leave a remnant,
D573.bottom: that ye may have some that shall escape the sword...
D573.verse: Yet will I leave a remnant, that ye may have some that shall escape the sword among the nations, when ye shall be scattered through the countries.
D573.snip: Yet will I leave a remnant

D574.title: Mark
D574.top: and set a mark upon the foreheads
D574.bottom: of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations...
D574.verse: And the LORD said unto him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof.
D574.snip: and set a mark upon the foreheads

D575.title: Word
D575.top: For I am the LORD: I will speak,
D575.bottom: and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass...
D575.verse: For I am the LORD: I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass; it shall be no more prolonged: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I say the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord GOD.
D575.snip: For I am the LORD: I will speak

D576.title: Repent
D576.top: Repent, and turn yourselves from your idols;
D576.bottom: and turn away your faces from all your abominations.
D576.verse: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Repent, and turn yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.
D576.snip: Repent, and turn yourselves from your idols

D250.title: Establish
D250.top: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant...
D250.bottom: ...and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.
D250.verse: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.
D250.snip: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant

D577.title: Cedar
D577.top: In the mountain of the height of Israel...
D577.bottom: ...bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar...
D577.verse: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it: and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.
D577.snip: In the mountain of the height of Israel

D578.title: Sanctify
D578.top: I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign
D578.bottom: between me and them... that I am the LORD that sanctify them.
D578.verse: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am the LORD that sanctify them.
D578.snip: I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign

D579.title: Right
D579.top: and it shall be no more, until he come
D579.bottom: whose right it is; and I will give it him.
D579.verse: I will overturn, overturn, overturn, it: and it shall be no more, until he come whose right it is; and I will give it him.
D579.snip: and it shall be no more, until he come

D580.title: Cast
D580.bottom: and cast me behind thy back...
D580.verse: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.

D581.title: Speak
D581.top: and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb:
D581.bottom: and thou shalt be a sign unto them...
D581.verse: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him which is escaped, and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb: and thou shalt be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
D581.snip: and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb

D582.title: Glory
D582.bottom: in the land of the living.
D582.verse: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time, and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I shall set glory in the land of the living;

D254.title: Plant
D254.top: ...and shall build houses, and plant vineyards;
D254.bottom: yea, they shall dwell with confidence...
D254.verse: And they shall dwell safely therein, and shall build houses, and plant vineyards; yea, they shall dwell with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them; and they shall know that I am the LORD their God.
D254.snip: ...and shall build houses, and plant vineyards

D583.title: Eden
D583.bottom: so that all the trees of Eden... in the garden of God...
D583.verse: I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches: so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied him.

D584.title: Deep
D584.top: Then will I make their waters deep,
D584.bottom: and cause their rivers to run like oil, saith the Lord GOD.
D584.verse: Then will I make their waters deep, and cause their rivers to run like oil, saith the Lord GOD.
D584.snip: Then will I make their waters deep

D255.title: Live
D255.top: None of his sins that he hath committed
D255.bottom: shall be mentioned unto him...he shall surely live.
D255.verse: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be mentioned unto him: he hath done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.
D255.snip: None of his sins that he hath committed

D585.title: New
D585.top: A new heart also will I give you,
D585.bottom: and a new spirit will I put within you...
D585.verse: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.
D585.snip: A new heart also will I give you

D257.title: Live
D257.top: And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live,
D257.bottom: and I shall place you in your own land...
D257.verse: And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall ye know that I the LORD have spoken it , and performed it , saith the LORD .
D257.snip: And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live

D586.title: Pour
D586.top: Neither will I hide my face any more from them:
D586.bottom: for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Israel...
D586.verse: Neither will I hide my face any more from them: for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.
D586.snip: Neither will I hide my face any more from them

D587.title: Hear
D587.top: behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears,
D587.bottom: and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee...
D587.verse: And the man said unto me, Son of man, behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears, and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee; for to the intent that I might shew them unto thee art thou brought hither: declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel.
D587.snip: behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears

D588.title: Sanctuary
D588.top: it had a wall round about...
D588.bottom: to make a separation between the sanctuary...
D588.verse: He measured it by the four sides: it had a wall round about, five hundred reeds long, and five hundred broad, to make a separation between the sanctuary and the profane place.
D588.snip: it had a wall round about

D258.title: Shine
D258.top: ...and his voice was like a noise of many waters:
D258.bottom: and the earth shined with his glory.
D258.verse: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east: and his voice was like a noise of many waters: and the earth shined with his glory.
D258.snip: ...and his voice was like a noise of many waters

D259.title: Holy
D259.top: And they shall teach my people
D259.bottom: the difference between the holy and profane...
D259.verse: And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and profane, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.
D259.snip: And they shall teach my people

D589.title: Balance
D589.bottom: and a just ephah, and a just bath.
D589.verse: Ye shall have just balances, and a just ephah, and a just bath.

D261.title: Purpose
D261.top: But Daniel purposed in his heart
D261.bottom: that he would not defile himself...
D261.verse: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king’s meat, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.
D261.snip: But Daniel purposed in his heart

D590.title: Secret
D590.top: He revealeth the deep and secret things:
D590.bottom: he knoweth what is in the darkness...
D590.verse: He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knoweth what is in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him.
D590.snip: He revealeth the deep and secret things

D591.title: Fire
