D658.verse: And now why tarriest thou? arise, and be baptized, and wash away thy sins, calling on the name of the Lord.
D658.snip: ...arise, and be baptized, and wash away

D318.title: Cheer
D318.top: ...the Lord stood by him, and said,
D318.verse: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.
D318.snip: ...the Lord stood by him, and said

D319.title: Turn
D319.top: To open their eyes, and to turn them
D319.bottom: from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan...
D319.verse: To open their eyes, and to turn them from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan unto God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins, and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me.
D319.snip: To open their eyes, and to turn them

D659.title: Cheer
D659.top: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer:
D659.bottom: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.
D659.verse: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.
D659.snip: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer

D320.title: Gospel
D320.top: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ:
D320.bottom: for it is the power of God unto salvation...
D320.verse: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
D320.snip: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ

D660.title: Lead
D660.top: ...not knowing that the goodness of God
D660.verse: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?
D660.snip: ...not knowing that the goodness of God

D661.title: Heir
D661.bottom: heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ...
D661.verse: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.

D325.title: Abound
D325.top: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy
D325.bottom: and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope...
D325.verse: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
D325.snip: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy

D326.title: Temple
D326.top: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God,
D326.bottom: and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?
D326.verse: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?
D326.snip: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God

D327.title: Glorify
D327.top: For ye are bought with a price:
D327.bottom: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit...
D327.verse: For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God’s.
D327.snip: For ye are bought with a price

D662.title: Edify
D662.verse: Now as touching things offered unto idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but charity edifieth.

D328.title: Escape
D328.top: ...God is faithful... with the temptation also
D328.bottom: make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.
D328.verse: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.
D328.snip: ...God is faithful... with the temptation also

D663.title: Body
D663.top: Now ye are the body of Christ,
D663.verse: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.
D663.snip: Now ye are the body of Christ

D329.title: Charity
D329.top: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three;
D329.bottom: but the greatest of these is charity.
D329.verse: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
D329.snip: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three

D664.title: Seal
D664.top: Who hath also sealed us, and given
D664.bottom: the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.
D664.verse: Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.
D664.snip: Who hath also sealed us, and given

D331.title: Vessel
D331.top: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels,
D331.bottom: that the excellency of the power may be of God...
D331.verse: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
D331.snip: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels

D665.title: Reconcile
D665.top: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ,
D665.verse: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ’s stead, be ye reconciled to God.
D665.snip: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ

D332.title: Rich
D332.bottom: that ye through his poverty might be rich.
D332.verse: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.

D666.title: Crucify
D666.top: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live;
D666.bottom: yet not I, but Christ liveth in me...
D666.verse: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
D666.snip: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live

D334.title: Children
D334.top: For ye are all the children of God
D334.verse: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
D334.snip: For ye are all the children of God

D667.title: Gain
D667.top: For to me to live is Christ,
D667.verse: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
D667.snip: For to me to live is Christ

D668.title: Mystery
D668.top: ...the riches of the glory of this mystery
D668.bottom: ...which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
D668.verse: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
D668.snip: ...the riches of the glory of this mystery

D340.title: Heartily
D340.top: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily,
D340.bottom: as to the Lord, and not unto men;
D340.verse: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
D340.snip: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily

D341.title: Meet
D341.top: ...caught up... to meet the Lord in the air:
D341.bottom: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
D341.verse: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
D341.snip: ...caught up... to meet the Lord in the air

D669.title: Peace
D669.top: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly;
D669.bottom: ...your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved...
D669.verse: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
D669.snip: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly

D342.title: Save
D342.bottom: to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
D342.verse: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

D670.title: Content
D670.verse: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

D345.title: Study
D345.top: Study to shew thyself approved unto God,
D345.bottom: a workman that needeth not to be ashamed...
D345.verse: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
D345.snip: Study to shew thyself approved unto God

D347.title: Honour
D347.top: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower
D347.bottom: than the angels... crowned with glory and honour...
D347.verse: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.
D347.snip: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower

D671.title: Anchor
D671.top: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul,
D671.verse: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;
D671.snip: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul

D349.title: Profess
D349.top: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith
D349.bottom: without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
D349.verse: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
D349.snip: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith

D672.title: Desire
D672.top: But now they desire a better country,
D672.bottom: ...for he hath prepared for them a city.
D672.verse: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.
D672.snip: But now they desire a better country

D673.title: Doer
D673.top: But be ye doers of the word,
D673.bottom: and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
D673.verse: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
D673.snip: But be ye doers of the word

D352.title: Lift
D352.top: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord,
D352.bottom: and he shall lift you up.
D352.verse: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.
D352.snip: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord

D674.title: Priest
D674.top: But ye are a chosen generation,
D674.bottom: a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people...
D674.verse: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
D674.snip: But ye are a chosen generation

D355.title: Cleanse
D355.top: ...he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins,
D355.bottom: and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
D355.verse: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
D355.snip: ...he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins

D675.title: Advocate
D675.top: ...we have an advocate with the Father,
D675.verse: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
D675.snip: ...we have an advocate with the Father

D356.title: Overcome
D356.top: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world:
D356.bottom: and this is the victory... even our faith.
D356.verse: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
D356.snip: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world

D357.title: Walk
D357.top: I have no greater joy than to hear
D357.bottom: that my children walk in truth.
D357.verse: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.
D357.snip: I have no greater joy than to hear

D676.title: Alpha
D676.top: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning
D676.bottom: and the ending, saith the Lord...
D676.verse: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
D676.snip: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning

D677.title: Nations
D677.top: ...a great multitude, which no man could number,
D677.bottom: of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues...
D677.verse: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;
D677.snip: ...a great multitude, which no man could number

D360.title: Reign
D360.top: ...the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ;
D360.bottom: and he shall reign for ever and ever.
D360.verse: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.
D360.snip: ...the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ

D361.title: Word
D361.top: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb,
D361.bottom: and by the word of their testimony...
D361.verse: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.
D361.snip: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb

D362.title: Marvel
D362.top: Great and marvellous are thy works,
D362.bottom: Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways...
D362.verse: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways, thou King of saints.
D362.snip: Great and marvellous are thy works

D678.title: Come
D678.bottom: that ye be not partakers of her sins...
D678.verse: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.

D679.title: Alleluia
D679.bottom: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.
D679.verse: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.
